question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Facade
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"facade"** means a deceptive outward appearance or the front of a building. (मुखौटा, बाहरी आवरण)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite her cheerful** facade**, she was actually feeling very lonely.
 
 
 
• **"Truth" **refers to the state of being true or in accordance with fact or reality; it is the opposite of a facade. (सत्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He finally revealed the** truth** about what happened that night.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'facade' **is **'truth'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Truth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hidden **(छुपा हुआ): Something that is not visible or not meant to be seen.

 
 
• **Example:** The treasure was hidden deep within the cave.
 
 
 
• **Opening **(खुलना): An open space through which things can pass.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a small opening in the fence where the dog escaped.
 
 
 
• **Closure** (समापन): The act of closing or bringing to an end.
 
 
• **Example:** The closure of the factory resulted in many job losses.
